```{r load}
sample_info <- read_csv("../tables/sample_info_combined.csv", show_col_types = FALSE)
df_TE       <- read_csv("../tables/translation_efficiency.csv", show_col_types = FALSE)
df_ONT      <- read_csv("../tables/gene_fraction&tail_length.csv", show_col_types = FALSE)

df_c1_raw <- read_tsv("../output_tables/df_fit_output_c1.txt",
                      show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
  left_join(sample_info, join_by(experiment_strain_condition)) %>%
  filter(condition == "WT")

df_consensus <- df_c1_raw %>%
  filter(std.error_log_k < 0.75) %>%
  pivot_wider(id_cols     = gene_id,
              names_from  = label,
              values_from = estimate_half_life,
              names_glue  = "{label}_hl") %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(MS96_small_hl), !is.na(MS1039_small_hl),
    !is.na(MS96_large_hl), !is.na(MS1039_large_hl),
    MS96_small_hl  > 0,    MS1039_small_hl  > 0,
    MS96_large_hl  > 0,    MS1039_large_hl  > 0) %>%
  mutate(
    WT_small_hl = rowMeans(across(c(MS96_small_hl, MS1039_small_hl)), na.rm = TRUE),
    WT_large_hl = rowMeans(across(c(MS96_large_hl, MS1039_large_hl)), na.rm = TRUE),
    WT_hl_fc    = log2(WT_large_hl / WT_small_hl)
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(WT_hl_fc), is.finite(WT_hl_fc)) %>%
  dplyr::select(gene_id, WT_small_hl, WT_large_hl, WT_hl_fc)

df_combined <- df_consensus %>%
  left_join(
    df_TE %>% dplyr::select(gene_id,
                             TE_rRNAdep_MandP_small_YM,
                             TE_rRNAdep_MandP_large_YM,
                             TPMsc_input_small_YM,
                             TPMsc_input_large_YM),
    join_by(gene_id)) %>%
  left_join(df_ONT, join_by(gene_id))

## Load replicate data for reproducibility panels
hl_files <- dir(path = "../output_tables/",
                pattern = ".*output.*\\.txt",
                full.names = TRUE)

df_hl_wide <- hl_files %>%
  map(~read_tsv(., show_col_types = FALSE)) %>%
  set_names(substr(basename(hl_files),
                   nchar(basename(hl_files)) - 5,
                   nchar(basename(hl_files)) - 4)) %>%
  bind_rows(.id = "fitting_strategy") %>%
  left_join(sample_info, join_by(experiment_strain_condition)) %>%
  filter(condition == "WT") %>%
  pivot_wider(id_cols     = gene_id,
              names_from  = c(label, fitting_strategy),
              values_from = estimate_half_life,
              names_glue  = "{label}_estimate_half_life_by_{fitting_strategy}")

df_rep <- df_hl_wide %>%
  dplyr::select(gene_id,
                MS96_small   = MS96_small_estimate_half_life_by_c1,
                MS96_large   = MS96_large_estimate_half_life_by_c1,
                MS1039_small = MS1039_small_estimate_half_life_by_c1,
                MS1039_large = MS1039_large_estimate_half_life_by_c1) %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(MS96_small),  !is.na(MS1039_small),
    !is.na(MS96_large),  !is.na(MS1039_large),
    MS96_small  > 0,     MS1039_small  > 0,
    MS96_large  > 0,     MS1039_large  > 0)

n_genes <- nrow(df_consensus)
n_rep   <- nrow(df_rep)
cat("Consensus genes:", n_genes, "\n")
cat("Replicate genes:", n_rep, "\n")
```

```{r helpers}
cell_theme <- theme_classic(base_size = 26) +
  theme(
    axis.title        = element_text(size = 22, colour = "black"),
    axis.text         = element_text(size = 20, colour = "black"),
    axis.line         = element_line(colour = "black", linewidth = 0.6),
    axis.ticks        = element_line(colour = "black", linewidth = 0.6),
    axis.ticks.length = unit(4, "pt"),
    panel.border      = element_blank(),
    plot.tag          = element_text(size = 28, face = "bold", colour = "black"),
    plot.tag.position = "topleft",
    plot.title        = element_blank(),
    legend.position   = "none",
    plot.margin       = margin(16, 16, 16, 16),
    plot.background   = element_rect(fill = "white", colour = NA)
  )

r_label <- function(x, y) {
  keep <- !is.na(x) & !is.na(y) & is.finite(x) & is.finite(y)
  r    <- round(cor(x[keep], y[keep], method = "spearman"), 3)
  paste0("R = ", r)
}

n_label <- function(x, y) {
  keep <- !is.na(x) & !is.na(y) & is.finite(x) & is.finite(y)
  paste0("n = ", format(sum(keep), big.mark = ","))
}

make_panel_binned <- function(data, x_col, y_col, x_lab, y_lab,
                              point_col     = "royalblue3",
                              filter_y_pos  = TRUE,
                              show_diagonal = FALSE,
                              bins          = 20,
                              ylim          = NULL,
                              xlim          = NULL) {
  df <- data %>%
    filter(!is.na(.data[[x_col]]), !is.na(.data[[y_col]]),
           is.finite(.data[[x_col]]), is.finite(.data[[y_col]]),
           .data[[x_col]] > 0)
  if (filter_y_pos) {
    df <- df %>% filter(.data[[y_col]] > 0)
  }
  df <- df %>%
    mutate(x = log2(.data[[x_col]]),
           y = if (filter_y_pos) log2(.data[[y_col]]) else .data[[y_col]])

  df_bin <- if (!is.null(xlim)) filter(df, x >= xlim[1], x <= xlim[2]) else df

  bin_sum <- Hmisc::cut2(df_bin$x, g = bins) %>%
    bind_cols(df_bin$x, df_bin$y) %>%
    dplyr::rename(bin = 1, x = 2, y = 3) %>%
    drop_na() %>%
    group_by(bin) %>%
    summarise(x = mean(x), y = mean(y), .groups = "drop")

  r_text <- r_label(df$x, df$y)
  n_text <- n_label(df$x, df$y)

  p <- ggplot(df, aes(x = x, y = y)) +
    geom_point(size = 2, alpha = 0.25, colour = point_col) +
    geom_line(data = bin_sum, aes(x = x, y = y),
              colour = "black", linewidth = 1.2) +
    annotate("text", x = -Inf, y = Inf,
             label = r_text, hjust = -0.1, vjust = 1.5,
             size  = 10, colour = "black") +
    annotate("text", x = -Inf, y = Inf,
             label = n_text, hjust = -0.1, vjust = 3.5,
             size  = 8, colour = "grey40") +
    labs(x = x_lab, y = y_lab) +
    cell_theme

  if (show_diagonal) {
    p <- p + geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0,
                         colour    = "grey60",
                         linewidth = 0.5,
                         linetype  = "dashed")
  }
  if (!is.null(ylim) & !is.null(xlim)) {
    p <- p + coord_cartesian(xlim = xlim, ylim = ylim)
  } else if (!is.null(ylim)) {
    p <- p + coord_cartesian(ylim = ylim)
  } else if (!is.null(xlim)) {
    p <- p + coord_cartesian(xlim = xlim)
  }
  p
}
```

```{r build_panels}
## Panel A -- replicate reproducibility, small and large cells
pA1 <- make_panel_binned(df_rep,
                         "MS96_small", "MS1039_small",
                         "MS96 hl, small (log2(min))",
                         "MS1039 hl, small (log2(min))",
                         point_col     = col_small,
                         show_diagonal = TRUE) +
  labs(tag = "A")

pA2 <- make_panel_binned(df_rep,
                         "MS96_large", "MS1039_large",
                         "MS96 hl, large (log2(min))",
                         "MS1039 hl, large (log2(min))",
                         point_col     = col_large,
                         show_diagonal = TRUE)

## Panel B -- half-life small vs large
pB <- make_panel_binned(df_combined,
                        "WT_small_hl", "WT_large_hl",
                        "Half-life, small cells (log2(min))",
                        "Half-life, large cells (log2(min))",
                        point_col     = col_A,
                        show_diagonal = TRUE) +
  labs(tag = "B")

## Panel C -- half-life vs TPM
pC1 <- make_panel_binned(df_combined,
                         "TPMsc_input_small_YM", "WT_small_hl",
                         "TPM, input (log2)",
                         "Half-life (log2(min))",
                         point_col = col_small) +
  labs(tag = "C")

pC2 <- make_panel_binned(df_combined,
                         "TPMsc_input_large_YM", "WT_large_hl",
                         "TPM, input (log2)",
                         "Half-life (log2(min))",
                         point_col = col_large)

## Panel D -- half-life vs TE
pD1 <- make_panel_binned(df_combined,
                         "TE_rRNAdep_MandP_small_YM", "WT_small_hl",
                         "Translation efficiency (log2)",
                         "Half-life (log2(min))",
                         point_col = col_small) +
  labs(tag = "D")

pD2 <- make_panel_binned(df_combined,
                         "TE_rRNAdep_MandP_large_YM", "WT_large_hl",
                         "Translation efficiency (log2)",
                         "Half-life (log2(min))",
                         point_col = col_large)

## Panel E -- half-life vs poly(A) tail, cropped x axis
pE1 <- make_panel_binned(df_combined,
                         "MS69_small_mrl100_mean_tail_length", "WT_small_hl",
                         "poly(A) tail length (log2(nt))",
                         "Half-life (log2(min))",

                         xlim      = c(4, 6.5)) +

pE2 <- make_panel_binned(df_combined,
                         "MS69_large_mrl100_mean_tail_length", "WT_large_hl",
                         "poly(A) tail length (log2(nt))",
                         "Half-life (log2(min))",
                         point_col = col_large,
                         xlim      = c(4, 6.5))

## Panel F -- fold change vs half-life
pF1 <- make_panel_binned(df_combined,
                         "WT_small_hl", "WT_hl_fc",
                         "Half-life (log2(min))",

pF2 <- make_panel_binned(df_combined,
                         "WT_large_hl", "WT_hl_fc",

## Panel G -- fold change vs TE

                         "Translation efficiency (log2)",
```

```{r assemble}
## Same layout and dimensions as the version that worked
## Row 1: A pair (replicate) + B (wide, consensus hl)
## Row 2: C pair (TPM) + D pair (TE)
## Row 3: E pair (polyA) + F pair (FC vs hl)
## Row 4: G pair (FC vs TE) + spacers

row1 <- (pA1 | pA2 | pB | plot_spacer()) +
  plot_layout(widths = c(1, 1, 2, 1))

row2 <- (pC1 | pC2 | pD1 | pD2) +
  plot_layout(widths = c(1, 1, 1, 1))

row3 <- (pE1 | pE2 | pF1 | pF2) +
  plot_layout(widths = c(1, 1, 1, 1))

row4 <- (pG1 | pG2 | plot_spacer() | plot_spacer()) +
  plot_layout(widths = c(1, 1, 1, 1))

caption_text <- paste0(
  "(A) Replicate reproducibility of mRNA half-life estimates between MS96 and MS1039 ",
  "in small (purple, left) and large (pink, right) cells (c1 fitting, SE < 0.75, n = ",
  n_rep, "). Dashed line indicates identity. Binned mean shown in black. ",
  "(B) mRNA half-life in small versus large WT cells (n = ", n_genes, "). ",
  "Points above the dashed diagonal indicate global stabilisation in large cells ",
  "(Spearman R = 0.79). Binned mean shown in black. ",
  "(C) mRNA half-life versus input TPM in small (purple, left) and large (pink, right) cells. ",
  "Positive correlation confirms highly expressed genes have more stable mRNA. ",
  "(D) mRNA half-life versus size-separated translation efficiency (monosome + polysome) ",
  "in small (purple, left) and large (pink, right) cells. Positive correlation is consistent ",
  "with codon-optimality-mediated co-translational decay. ",
  "(E) mRNA half-life versus mean poly(A) tail length in small (purple, left) and large ",
  "(pink, right) cells. x-axis cropped to show bulk of distribution, one outlier excluded. ",
  "Negative correlation reflects deadenylation-dependent decay, maintained across cell sizes. ",
  "(F) Half-life fold change (log2 large/small) versus consensus half-life in small ",
  "(purple, left) and large (pink, right) cells. Binned mean shown in black. ",
  "Opposite sign of Spearman R indicates genes stable in small cells do not gain ",
  "further stability in large cells. ",
  "(G) Half-life fold change versus translation efficiency in small (purple, left) and ",
  "large (pink, right) cells. Near-zero R indicates TE does not predict size-dependent ",
  "changes in mRNA stability. All correlations Spearman, binned mean shown in all panels.")

p_caption <- ggplot() +
  geom_textbox(
    aes(x = 0, y = 1, label = caption_text),
    hjust      = 0, vjust = 1,
    width      = unit(24, "inch"),
    size       = 9,
    lineheight = 1.6,
    fill       = "white",
    colour     = "black",
    box.colour = NA) +
  scale_x_continuous(limits = c(0, 1), expand = c(0, 0)) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 1), expand = c(0, 0)) +
  theme_void() +
  theme(plot.background = element_rect(fill = "white", colour = NA))

panel_plots <- row1 / row2 / row3 / row4 +
  plot_layout(heights = c(1, 1, 1, 1))

final <- cowplot::plot_grid(
  panel_plots,
  p_caption,
  ncol        = 1,
  rel_heights = c(14, 5))

ggsave("../figures/Figure_panel1.png",
       plot   = final,
       width  = 24,
       height = 34,
       dpi    = 150)

cat("Saved Figure_panel1.png\n")
```

```{r correlation_matrix}
load("reproducibility_functions.rda")

fitting_strategies <- c("a1", "b1", "b2", "b3", "c1")

r_summary <- map_dfr(fitting_strategies, function(fs) {
  df <- df_hl_wide %>%
    filter(
      !is.na(.data[[paste0("MS96_small_estimate_half_life_by_",   fs)]]),
      !is.na(.data[[paste0("MS1039_small_estimate_half_life_by_", fs)]]),
      !is.na(.data[[paste0("MS96_large_estimate_half_life_by_",   fs)]]),
      !is.na(.data[[paste0("MS1039_large_estimate_half_life_by_", fs)]]),
      .data[[paste0("MS96_small_estimate_half_life_by_",   fs)]] > 0,
      .data[[paste0("MS1039_small_estimate_half_life_by_", fs)]] > 0,
      .data[[paste0("MS96_large_estimate_half_life_by_",   fs)]] > 0,
      .data[[paste0("MS1039_large_estimate_half_life_by_", fs)]] > 0)

  tibble(
    fitting_strategy = fs,
    R_small_hl = cor(
      log2(df[[paste0("MS96_small_estimate_half_life_by_",   fs)]]),
      log2(df[[paste0("MS1039_small_estimate_half_life_by_", fs)]]),
      method = "spearman", use = "complete.obs"),
    R_large_hl = cor(
      log2(df[[paste0("MS96_large_estimate_half_life_by_",   fs)]]),
      log2(df[[paste0("MS1039_large_estimate_half_life_by_", fs)]]),
      method = "spearman", use = "complete.obs"),
    R_fc = cor(
      log2(df[[paste0("MS96_small_estimate_half_life_by_",   fs)]]) -
      log2(df[[paste0("MS96_large_estimate_half_life_by_",   fs)]]),
      log2(df[[paste0("MS1039_small_estimate_half_life_by_", fs)]]) -
      log2(df[[paste0("MS1039_large_estimate_half_life_by_", fs)]]),
      method = "spearman", use = "complete.obs")
  )
})

r_long <- r_summary %>%
  pivot_longer(cols      = c(R_small_hl, R_large_hl, R_fc),
               names_to  = "metric",
               values_to = "R") %>%
  mutate(
    metric = recode(metric,
                    R_small_hl = "Half-life, small cells",
                    R_large_hl = "Half-life, large cells",
                    R_fc       = "Fold change"),
    metric           = factor(metric, levels = c("Half-life, small cells",
                                                  "Half-life, large cells",
                                                  "Fold change")),
    fitting_strategy = factor(fitting_strategy,
                              levels = c("a1", "b1", "b2", "b3", "c1")))

p_matrix <- ggplot(r_long, aes(x = fitting_strategy, y = metric, fill = R)) +
  geom_tile(colour = "white", linewidth = 1) +
  geom_text(aes(label = round(R, 3)),
            size = 10, colour = "white", fontface = "bold") +
 scale_fill_gradient(low  = "#ffa8cb",
                    high = "#4575b4",
                    limits = c(0, 1),
                    name   = "Spearman R") +
  labs(x = "Fitting strategy",
       y = NULL) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 26) +
  theme(
    axis.title      = element_text(size = 22, colour = "black"),
    axis.text       = element_text(size = 20, colour = "black"),
    axis.line       = element_blank(),
    axis.ticks      = element_blank(),
    legend.position = "right",
    legend.title    = element_text(size = 18),
    legend.text     = element_text(size = 16),
    plot.background = element_rect(fill = "white", colour = NA),
    plot.margin     = margin(20, 20, 20, 20))

p_matrix

ggsave("../figures/correlation_matrix.png",
       plot   = p_matrix,
       width  = 14,
       height = 8,
       dpi    = 150)
caption_matrix <- paste0(
  "Spearman R between biological replicates (MS96 and MS1039) for mRNA half-life estimates ",
  "across five fitting strategies (a1, b1, b2, b3, c1) in small and large WT yeast cells, ",
  "and for the log2 half-life fold change (large/small). ",
  "Half-life estimates were derived from EU pulse-chase mRNA-seq time course data using ",
  "exponential decay fitting, fitting strategies differ in sample filtering and weighting. ",
  "c1 applies the most stringent filtering (TPM input > 5, TPM EU min > 2, exclusion of ",
  "two low-quality MS1039 samples) and shows the highest replicate reproducibility across ",
  "all three metrics. c1 was therefore selected for all subsequent analyses. ",
  "Colour scale ranges from low (pink) to high (blue) Spearman R.")

p_matrix_caption <- ggplot() +
  geom_textbox(
    aes(x = 0, y = 1, label = caption_matrix),
    hjust      = 0, vjust = 1,
    width      = unit(13, "inch"),
    size       = 5.5,
    lineheight = 1.6,
    fill       = "white",
    colour     = "black",
    box.colour = NA) +
  scale_x_continuous(limits = c(0, 1), expand = c(0, 0)) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 1), expand = c(0, 0)) +
  theme_void() +
  theme(plot.background = element_rect(fill = "white", colour = NA))

matrix_final <- cowplot::plot_grid(
  p_matrix,
  p_matrix_caption,
  ncol        = 1,
  rel_heights = c(6, 2))

ggsave("../figures/correlation_matrix.png",
       plot   = matrix_final,
       width  = 14,
       height = 10,
       dpi    = 150)

cat("Saved CW_correlation_matrix.png\n")
cat("Saved CW_correlation_matrix.png\n")
```
